Anything to merge here?

Two branches are unmerged. One is ready; the other needs your go-ahead.

- **[PR #5](https://github.com/polarizetech/neural-memory/pull/5) (`chore/drop-sim-prefix`) is ready to merge.** It changes the name in README, CLAUDE.md, FINDINGS and one line in `monorepo.py` and its test. Lint passes and it has no conflicts.
  - One stale detail it misses: CLAUDE.md still calls the repo "private". It's public now, so I'd fix that before merging.
- **`chore/kit-ap-update` has no PR.** It updates the preregistration kit from `e64136a` to the latest `6841edc` (13 files, including the `tag` and `prereg-status` tools).
  - The session-start check also reports the kit as out of date. The kit's own rule says not to update without your go-ahead.
- Nothing else is unmerged. The working tree has only the session logger's own appends.

Should I:

- merge PR #5, with the CLAUDE.md "private" → "public" fix added first;
- open a PR for the kit update and merge it?

Separately, the blog post and the research entry still link to `sim-neural-memory`. GitHub redirects those links, so they work; say if you want them updated to the new name.

Yeah, like whatever you think, just get it all merged so that we don't lose anything. And then, yeah, update the any entries that are util or that are referencing the sim dash. Update those. And then just let me know, make sure that everything's working.
